This built-in chatbot is designed to help you write high-quality dataset notebooks. It can assist with:
– how to use the scratch drive, reference the
directory, and work within the MSD-LIVE environment
– managing notebooks, running cells, and navigating the interface
– writing Python code to parse, analyze, and visualize your dataset
– organizing notebooks, debugging, and improving workflow efficiency
Use it whenever you need quick guidance or examples while developing your notebooks.
